jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Inkitt is building the Disney of the 21st Century, standing at the forefront of technology and entertainment. Leveraging AI and predictive algorithms, Inkitt discovers unknown stories and turns them into blockbuster hits, producing a new $1M ebook every 7 days and selling directly to consumers through its Inkitt Galatea app. Bestsellers are then translated onto the screen through Inkitt CandyJar, the #1 US-based microdrama platform with billions of episodes streamed to date. Inkitt has become the 11th most bestseller-generating publisher in the world, boasting a 40x higher hit-rate than traditional publishers. Backed by some of the top VC’s such as: Khosla, Kleiner Perkins, and NEA Ventures, our recent expansion into Ironblood, the first AI Native streaming platform for action and adventure, is only the beginning of our journey to becoming the next-gen entertainment powerhouse.
 
 
Which product you'll own
We run four consumer products and we are hiring product managers for all of them.
Galatea — serialized fiction, millions of readers, coins and subscription
CandyJar — the #1 US-based microdrama platform, billions of episodes streamed
Ironblood — our new AI-native streaming platform for action and adventure
Inkitt — the writing and discovery platform underneath all of it, where the stories come from
We decide which one you own at the point you start, not at the point you apply. When you join, we look at where the largest metric gap is across the portfolio and put you there. As the team grows, areas get reshuffled — people move to where the biggest problem is.
We are telling you this up front because it is a real feature of working here, and because it does not suit everyone. If you want to own one named surface for three years, this is the wrong company. Some of our strongest product managers were hired for one thing and were doing something else entirely within a year — including one who was brought in to build internal tooling and ended up launching CandyJar from zero.
 
How We Work — please read this part carefully
This role works differently from most product jobs, and the difference matters more than anything else on this page.
Ali, our founder and CEO, sets company priorities. You own the ideas. You will own an app or area end to end, and you will spend part of every day researching competitors, the industry and our users to generate new feature ideas. Every product manager here keeps a live Top 3 list of the highest-impact ideas for their area — a new idea only enters that list by beating one already on it.
You pitch ideas to Ali on a single slide with a rough impact calculation attached. He rejects the ones that will not move the number enough to justify building them. That happens often, to everyone, and it is not a signal that anything has gone wrong.
Once an idea is approved, you own execution: spec, design, engineering, launch, and the A/B test. You release and ramp tests on your own judgement. Four weeks after launch, every feature is reviewed against the impact you predicted before you built it.
Your performance is measured on exactly two things: how often you beat your own Top 3, and the realised impact of what you ship.
If that sounds like the job you want, the rest of this page is for you.

What You'll Do:
- Own an app or area end to end — the roadmap, the backlog, the revenue and retention of it

- Generate the ideas. Research competitors, the market and our users daily, and keep a ranked Top 3 that you are constantly trying to beat

- Build the impact case before you build the feature: size the opportunity, show the maths, defend the number

- Pitch to Ali, take the rejection, sharpen it, come back

- Drive approved work through spec, design, engineering, QA and launch

- Design and run A/B tests, ramp them responsibly, and read the results honestly — including when you lost

- Publish what you learn, wins and losses alike, to the whole company

- Hit the impact you predicted
What You'll Bring:
- 4–10 years of professional experience. We do not require a set number of years with the title “product manager.” Several of our strongest PMs arrived with one to three, and one of our best had none at all.

- At least one role, in any function, in a business where money changed hands frequently and directly — subscriptions, in-app purchases, payments, pricing, marketplaces, live operations, lifecycle marketing. We care that you have seen how revenue actually behaves, not that you have the product vocabulary for it. Analysts, BD, CRM, payments operations and growth marketers are all welcome here.

- Numbers you produce yourself. You can size an opportunity, build the model, and write the SQL or the spreadsheet underneath it. You do not wait for an analyst to tell you whether something worked.

- Evidence you have moved toward the product rather than the title — a lateral or downward title move to get closer to building something, or two or three functions inside one company.

- Something you started that nobody asked you to start. A side project, a club, a process, a business, a team you created because it needed to exist.

- Shipped work with numbers attached. Tell us what moved and by how much.

- Consumer product instinct and real UX judgement.

- Based in San Francisco. This role is five days a week onsite.

- Nice to have: free-to-play games, serialized fiction, short-form video, audio or another high-frequency consumer content business; coins, virtual currency, offer design or live operations; mobile; a founder or first-employee stint.
Who We Are Looking For:
- Generates ideas rather than waiting for them

- Brings solutions instead of problems

- Data driven — and does the analysis themselves

- Quick to action

- Takes direct feedback well and gives it

- Comfortable being measured against their own forecast

- Happy to be moved to wherever the biggest problem is

- Looking for exponential career growth

- Have lots of fun building a generational AI x Entertainment company
What We'll Offer: 
- 401k plan, designed to help you save for the future

- Health benefits tailored to your needs, including medical, dental, and vision coverage

- Professional coaching for everyone

- Team-building events, including our annual Tulum trip

- Unlimited access to our Galatea app and CandyJar app.

- Unlimited budget for self-development books

- Charity donation of your choice at your one year anniversary

- Free lunch in office everyday

- Class Pass membership for US based employee and gym access for Berlin employees

- Dog-friendly offices in Berlin and San Francisco
At Inkitt, we strive to build a company culture and provide employment opportunities based on diversity and inclusion. We believe every author should have an equal opportunity to succeed, as should our team members. As a growing team from 20+ countries, we welcome everyone to apply. 
 
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
Inkitt is building the Disney of the 21st Century, standing at the forefront of technology and entertainment. Leveraging AI and predictive algorithms, Inkitt discovers unknown stories and turns them into blockbuster hits, producing a new $1M ebook every 7 days and selling directly to consumers through its Inkitt Galatea app. Bestsellers are then translated onto the screen through Inkitt CandyJar, the #1 US-based microdrama platform with billions of episodes streamed to date. The problem you’d own
Inkitt has more story than anyone can read. Galatea, CandyJar and Ironblood each depend on putting the right story in front of the right person at the right moment — and the quality of that match drives reading time, subscription conversion and renewal across all three apps.
We have a strong Data Science team, and they own the underlying signals and models. You own what users actually experience. Recommendations and discovery across every surface we have: home and feeds, search, browse, onboarding taste capture, notifications and re-engagement, and the cross-app connections between our four products. You decide what we put in front of someone next, everywhere we put anything in front of them — and you are accountable for the reading time, conversion and revenue that comes out of it.
 
How We Work — please read this part carefully
Ali, our founder and CEO, sets company priorities. You own the ideas. You will spend part of every day researching competitors, the industry and our users to generate new feature ideas, and you will keep a live Top 3 list of the highest-impact ideas for your area — a new idea only enters by beating one already on it.
You pitch on a single slide with a rough impact calculation attached. Ali rejects the ones that will not move the number enough to justify building them. That happens often, to everyone. The loop is pitch, get rejected, sharpen, re-pitch — continuously, alongside delivery.
Once approved, you own execution outright, including release and A/B ramping. Four weeks after launch, every feature is reviewed against the impact you predicted before you built it. Your performance is measured on two things: how often you beat your own Top 3, and the realised impact of what you ship.

What You’ll Do: 
- Own recommendations and discovery across Inkitt, Galatea, CandyJar and Ironblood — every surface where we decide what to put in front of someone next, plus the roadmap, experiments and revenue attached

- Design the experiences the models feed: home and feeds, search, browse, taste capture at onboarding, personalised notifications and re-engagement, cross-app discovery

- Partner closely with Data Science, who own the models and signals, on what those models need to predict and how we judge whether they got better

- Design and run recommendation experiments at a high cadence; ramp them on your own judgement; report results honestly including the losses

- Build the impact case before you build the feature. Know the difference between an offline metric moving and revenue moving

- Hit the impact you predicted
What You'll Bring: 
- 5–12 years of professional experience. We measure years on the job, not years holding a “product manager” title. If you came to product from data science, analytics or engineering, that is an advantage here rather than a gap.

- You have shipped a recommendation, ranking, search or personalisation system that real users felt — and you can explain what you changed, what moved, and how you knew it was causal.

- You understand how these systems work underneath. Candidate generation and ranking, cold start, feedback loops, popularity bias, exploration versus exploitation. You can hold your own with the people training the models.

- You can tell an offline win from a business win. Plenty of people have improved an NDCG. We care that you have moved reading time, conversion or renewal, and that you can show the experiment design behind it.

- Numbers you produce yourself. Advanced SQL. You build the analysis rather than commissioning it.

- Consumer product instinct — this is a reader-facing experience, not an internal tool.

- Based in San Francisco. This role is five days a week onsite.

- Nice to have: content or entertainment recommendations (streaming, serialized fiction, short-form video, audio, games); LLM-based ranking, embeddings or generative approaches to catalogue understanding; experience with a catalogue created in-house rather than uploaded by users.
Who We Are Looking For: 
- Generates ideas rather than waiting for them

- Brings solutions instead of problems

- Data driven — and does the analysis themselves

- Quick to action

- Comfortable being measured against their own forecast

- Looking for exponential career growth

- Have lots of fun building a generational AI x Entertainment company
What We’ll Offer: 
- 401k plan, designed to help you save for the future

- Health benefits tailored to your needs, including medical, dental, and vision coverage

- Professional coaching for everyone

- Team-building events, including our annual Tulum trip

- Unlimited access to our Galatea app and CandyJarTV app

- Unlimited budget for self-development books

- Charity donation of your choice at your one year anniversary

- Free lunch in office everyday

- Class Pass membership for US based employee and gym access for Berlin employees

- Dog-friendly offices in Berlin and San Francisco

It brings the creative and technical production workflow, from adaptation and shot generation to character consistency, music, editing, and quality evaluation, into one integrated platform. Cinematica is a leap toward our larger vision: becoming the operating system that enables storytellers to bring any story to life, in any format.
 
How We Work — please read this part carefully
Ali, our founder and CEO, sets company priorities. You own the ideas. - Own the Cinematica roadmap end to end — adaptation, shot generation, character and style consistency, music, editing and quality evaluation — and decide what gets built first, what gets cut, and what waits

- Turn a production process that today depends on individual judgement into a platform other people can run: our own studio first, then storytellers beyond Inkitt

- Define what "good" looks like for an Inkitt story on screen, write it down, and hold the line on it

- Build the evaluation system behind that bar: rubrics, benchmarks, blind comparisons and human review loops, so quality becomes something the team can measure and argue about with evidence rather than taste alone

- Own the model and prompt strategy, and the buy-versus-build calls underneath it, with engineering, design, analytics and user research

- Drive improvements through their entire product lifecycle: ideation, specification, development, release, analysis and iterations

- Run a tight iteration loop: ship, watch what viewers actually do, diagnose precisely what failed, feed it back into the pipeline, measure the delta

- Work shoulder to shoulder with our Creative Director and AI-Video Production team — your first users — turning craft judgement into systems that hold up without any one person in the room

- Educate and influence cross functional stakeholders and leadership to secure buy-in on the roadmap, and communicate your hypotheses and results to team members and leadership

- Make quality legible: report it as a number that moves, and connect it to what it does for retention and conversion

- Demonstrable taste. You can watch two pieces of generated video, articulate precisely why one is better, and turn that judgement into a rubric someone else can apply without you

- Proven track record owning the quality of creative output at scale, and building the systems that measured it — benchmarks, human eval, blind comparisons, A/B — plus a point of view on where automated metrics stop being useful. Generative AI, film and TV post-production, games, animation or creative tooling all count
